visualCharacteristics.layout: 1 column, stacked full-width panels skewed -17.76deg (700px min-height, 400px <=768px) sharing diagonal edges; image and content counter-skewed; alternating left/right content alignment
visualCharacteristics.notes: Odd panels: black bg + dark gradient overlay; even panels: sunlight-gold bg rgb(250,166,29) shows through transparent areas of the pattern PNGs; uppercase white heading 7rem with text-shadow; outlined white 'Learn More' button with double-chevron icon and drop-shadow

contentPattern: Each row: [background image | h2 heading + paragraph with 'Learn More' link]. Six rows in source order. Alternating alignment derived from row index in CSS (odd = left, even = right); PNG images are treated as patterns (no overlay), other images as photos (dark gradient overlay).
